source_contract: ProsperoEden/headless/network/transport.cpp:74-90,256-268; editor.cpp:51-53,75-85,158-186 (documentary source study, not a pinned repo contract)
endpoint: 192.0.2.20 is documentation-only (RFC 5737) and MUST NOT be contacted
note: No NFS parser/editor/transport exists in the Encore repository; these are declarative expectations for the future approved implementation, mirroring the A03/SMB fixture shape.

cases.change: id empty or 41 ASCII bytes; duplicate id; duplicate endpoint/export/folder with different id
port or mount_port = 0*, 65536, string, boolean, fractional (*mount_port 0 may mean auto: must be an explicit documented choice)

cases.expected_future_parse: open owner decision; AUTH_SYS numeric identity is not secure authentication; do not expose root identity without explicit policy
reject: outside verified NFSv3 scope; no silent downgrade and no v4/TLS claim

cases.change: SMB fields (user/password/domain/encrypt) present on protocol nfs
protocol switched nfs->smb or smb->nfs in a draft
cases.expected_future_parse: reset protocol-specific fields (source clears share plus SMB credentials); never carry credentials across protocols

cases.change: export/folder/updates_dir = ../escape, /absolute, a//b, a\b, a/%2e%2e, or trailing /
cases.expected_future_parse: reject each; export must be absolute and validated, relative paths safe

cases.change: timeout_ms = 249 or 15001; cache_mib = 0 or 33; >4 shares; unknown property; depth > 8; bytes > 65536; symlink/hardlink/nonregular node
malformed document then save; identity/bytes change between read and publication
cases.expected_future_parse: refuse; preserve original bytes; no overwrite (WriteOwned semantics)

runtime_acceptance_not_simulated: A trusted, externally quiescent, stable share is a precondition; the app cannot enforce it against external writers.
AUTH_SYS numeric UID/GID is not secure user authentication; app read-only mode is not a server permission.
Detected size/mtime/identity/namespace change poisons the whole session permanently; readers fail; cached bytes are unreachable; fresh launch with a new session is required.
Same-metadata content mutation is NOT detectable by this contract (fixture N04 documents it); no immutable-snapshot or malicious-server guarantee.
A failed read after copying a prefix is never success; guest-visible error must follow; no zero-fill success.
Disconnect/cancel invalidates old readers; reconnect never reattaches old handles (fixture N06).
No write/resize/rename route may reach the remote share; the interface offers none.
NSP/XCI/NRO discovered remotely and NSP/XCI add-ons only, one add-on level, documented bounds; no remote NSZ/XCZ/ExeFS support claim.
